description: This file defines the EmployeeSavedEvent class in the OrangeHRM project. It is a PHP source file implementing an event class that encapsulates details about an employee being saved, specifically holding an Employee entity object. It extends a base Event class and provides a constructor and a getter method for the Employee object.

classes.name: EmployeeSavedEvent
classes.description: An event class representing the moment an employee entity has been saved. It stores an Employee object and provides access to it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EmployeeSavedEvent with an Employee object.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this event.
